history.how: DAO proposal 8 + timelock: security review fixes
DAO proposal 9 + timelock: account_call callback frees only its own lock
DAO proposal 10 + timelock: F8 agent budget (set_agent, agent_send, agent_of)
DAO proposal 11 + timelock: F9 sign in as the NFT (EIP-4361); V2-9 account_call refuses lasting grants
DAO proposal 12 + timelock: V2-10 a sign-in can't outlive a sale (no sign-in while listed; no listing or approval while one is valid)
DAO proposal 13 + timelock: V2-10 the sign-in record survives a transfer; nft_transfer_call and loans gated too

DAO proposal 14 + timelock: V2-11 the NFT's account can only nft_transfer a Pusaka it holds (adversarial review); auth denylist; agent budget saturating and cleared on nft_transfer_call; no transfer into a token's own account; sign-in gate on gift
DAO proposal 15 + timelock: account_call takes an allowlist of asset-moving methods for every receiver; no nft_transfer of a signed-in Pusaka into a token account

DAO proposal 16 + timelock: F10 BIP-322 proof of the NFT's Bitcoin address, F11 renter (ERC-4907 user) who can sign in, F12 buy with native Bitcoin settled by the light client, F13 reserves view; heir claim waits for a reserved Bitcoin buyer
DAO proposal 17 + timelock: F12 reservation nonce never repeats per token (no payment replay after a resale); a paid buyer keeps the sale through a proof grace period
DAO proposal 18 + timelock: a Bitcoin txid that bought a Pusaka is spent for good; the hand-over checks the seller still holds the NFT
DAO proposal 19 + timelock: F14 vault with clawback, F15 covered calls
DAO proposal 20 + timelock: F16 a call whose strike is paid in native Bitcoin, proven by the light client
DAO proposal 21 + timelock: F16 in-flight proofs counted (a bogus proof can't block the genuine one); no OP_RETURN shown after the time to pay
DAO proposal 22 + timelock: F16 proofs need the reservation window; the call can't return to its writer; a lost callback stops counting after an hour
DAO proposal 24 + timelock (14 Nov): R6-1, reserve_btc_purchase takes expected_sign_epoch and refuses with StateChanged if anything was signed since the buyer looked
